core_ratio_by_flutes._source: Design values (not measured): 2-3 flutes 50-65 % (EP 1 072 345), 40-55 % (US 11,554,426), >= 60 % high-load (US 10,335,870); 4 flutes ~60 % (Mitsubishi 'Web thickness'), >= 58 %; 5 flutes >= 61-64 %, 6 flutes >= 63-65 % (US 10,335,870); 7 flutes flute depth 10-20 % of D, i.e. a 60-80 % core (CA 3 000 831 C, 7 teeth 'the most preferred ... taking into account flute space'); 5-8 flutes finishing 75-85 % (EP 1 072 345). docs/research/carbide_and_edge_radius.md §5, docs/research/chip_space.md §2

void_fraction.source: Engineering estimate: the share of the core-to-OD annulus that is open gullet rather than tooth body. It multiplies every flute count alike, so it cancels in the calibration of K (only the ratio between flute counts, set by the core table, matters)

enclosed_ae_over_D.source: a full slot: no open side for the chip to leave by

a0_over_D.source: engineering estimate: up to D/2 the chip clears the slot within the half revolution the tooth is enclosed (flute advance along a 30-45° helix)

k_d.source: engineering estimate, checked on the vendor slots: with k_d 0.5 the 2-flute slots at 0.6·D (OSG) and 3-flute slots at 1·D (YG-1, OSG, Helical) in aluminium fall on the same normalised packing (5.7-6.4); k_d 0 and 1 give 6.0 / 5.3 for the group minimum (sensitivity in docs/research/chip_space.md). Sandvik: reduce full-slot ap to ~70 % of the edge length and use compressed air against chip congestion

aggressiveness.basis: u_limit(a) = consensus_scale(a) / consensus_scale(1) (optimize.CONSENSUS_SCALE_POINTS): 1.0 at aggressiveness 1 (the most packed published slot), 0.84 at 50 %, 0.69 at 0. The same margin the engine keeps on its other vendor-anchored limit, C2, because K and the gullet geometry are uncertain (design values, one void fraction, no measured chip packing)

non-ferrous.basis: most packed published full slot: osg_BLIZZARD2022_al_slot_1-2 (OSG, 2 flutes, D 0.5", ap 0.60·D, fz 0.0250·D)

steel.basis: most packed published full slot: garr_vrx_h13_lt40_slot_1-16 (Garr Tool, 4 flutes, D 0.0625", ap 1.50·D, fz 0.0112·D)

stainless.basis: most packed published full slot: garr_vrx_17-4_lt40_slot_1-16 (Garr Tool, 4 flutes, D 0.0625", ap 1.50·D, fz 0.0096·D)

Ti-Ni-Co.basis: most packed published full slot: garr_vrx_ti64_nohrc_slot_1-16 (Garr Tool, 4 flutes, D 0.0625", ap 1.50·D, fz 0.0096·D)

calibration: tools/calibrate_chip_space.py: K = the smallest A_g/(fz·ae)/depth_factor over the group's square-end full-slot rows of tests/benchmarks/v2/*.json
